## Validation and limitations

The strategy retrieved all **7 of 7** screened development records. That is 100% relative recall against records used during development, not independent validation or sensitivity; no held-out set or independent benchmark was available. The psychological-theory block reduced the broader query by 58.5%; none of its refreshed 30-record loss sample met the eligibility criteria.

Two risks remain documented in the audit: the final count exceeds the standard 10,000-record workload budget, and the depression category probe found relevant mixed-affective records before its two-probe budget was exhausted. Terms were broadened to cover those findings, but a fresh probe could not be run afterward. Bipolar-only records retrieved by the broader `Mood Disorders` heading need screening.

I proceeded using the scope assumptions documented in the [narrative](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-3ef4260cbc2db74f/ours-codex-noseed-20260928T213214Z/work/narrative.md); you did not separately confirm the concepts and roles. The draft still needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.
